entries.3c48da09c68d3e91: Its mission is 'Finding the future within corporate value' and its vision is 'Let's deliver technology to small and medium-sized enterprises.' As medium- to long-term management strategies, for refining existing businesses it cites the 'AI Agent Concept', which aims to implement AI agents that combine multiple AI technologies to autonomously support decision-making and actions; for expanding new businesses, it cites overseas expansion of 'BIG ADVANCE GLOBAL', a shift to a revenue structure linked to transactions such as success fees, and promotion of financial DX through expanded sales of services for financial institutions. It also aims for discontinuous growth through M&A, centered on the 'regional network' domain.
entries.43239385f3a1d534: This is a single-segment business composed of the company, two consolidated subsidiaries (Kokopelli Management Support Co., Ltd. and Key Point Co., Ltd.), and one equity-method affiliate (SIAM KOKOPELLI Co., Ltd.). The company operates a BtoB/SaaS model platform supporting the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises, and its main offering is the management support platform 'Big Advance', which is provided to small and medium-sized business clients of regional financial institutions in cooperation with those institutions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,758 million.

entries.651555ce5f3357a7: A management support platform provided, in partnership with regional financial institutions and bearing each institution’s name, to the small and medium-sized enterprises that are their clients. It provides business matching, a messaging chat with financial institutions, information on subsidies and grants, automatic creation of websites, and the employee benefits coupon site “FUKURI” as a single package for a monthly fee of ¥3,000 (excluding tax). As of March 31, 2026, 76 financial institutions had introduced the platform, and the number of member companies was 53,895. Amounts by service are not separately disclosed.

entries.c9cabb1a0e2d0792: It is a company that rolls out a management support platform for SMEs nationwide through regional financial institutions. The number of 'Big Advance' member companies decreased from 60,172 (as of the end of March 2025) to 53,895 (as of the end of March 2026), and the number of introducing financial institutions decreased from 78 to 76. On the other hand, the average churn rate of member companies from April 2025 to March 2026 was 1.53%, remaining within the company's target of 2% or less.
